name: kiro-cli-chat
description: Chat with the Kiro CLI agent in VS Code on Macs without AVX/AVX2. Uses the headless v3 engine instead of the AVX-only terminal UI.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, workspace values for kiroCliChat.autopilot, kiroCliChat.defaultEngine, kiroCliChat.interactionMode and kiroCliChat.shareEditorContext are ignored. kiroCliChat.kiroCliPath is never read from workspace settings.

enumDescriptions: Open the chat as an editor tab (supports VS Code's native file-drop overlay: hold Shift to drop images/files).
Open the chat in the panel/side bar view (wherever you've moved it).
kiroCliChat.openIn.markdownDescription: Where **Open Chat** (`Cmd+Alt+K / Ctrl+Alt+K`, status bar) opens the chat. Each chat tab and the panel view is its own conversation.

kiroCliChat.kiroCliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `kiro-cli` binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (`kiro-cli` on PATH, then `~/.local/bin/kiro-cli`).

kiroCliChat.defaultEngine.markdownDescription: Agent engine to use. `auto` checks which engine runs on this machine (v3 today) and remembers it. The extension needs v3.

kiroCliChat.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for new sessions. `auto` lets Kiro choose per task. Valid values are listed by `kiro-cli chat --list-models`; you can also switch models live from the chat's model dropdown or `/model`.

kiroCliChat.interactionMode.markdownDescription: `persistent` uses the long-lived `kiro-cli acp` process (enables tool approvals and multi-turn in one process). `one-shot` spawns a process per turn with `--resume-id` (no live approvals).

kiroCliChat.autopilot.markdownDescription: When off (default), run in **Supervised** mode: the agent asks for approval before file changes. When on, tools run without confirmation.

kiroCliChat.shareEditorContext.markdownDescription: Tell the agent which files are open in the editor and which one is active (paths only, files inside the chat's folder only). Off by default.

kiroCliChat.enterToSend.description: Press Enter to send a message; Shift+Enter inserts a newline. If off, the behavior is reversed.

kiroCliChat.remote.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start remote access when VS Code starts (otherwise use **Kiro CLI Chat: Start Remote Access**). Machine setting: a workspace cannot turn it on.

kiroCliChat.remote.permissions.markdownDescription: What a paired remote device may do: `view` the chats, `prompt` (send, steer, stop, answer questions), `approve` (allow or deny a command once).

kiroCliChat.remote.httpsPort.markdownDescription: The HTTPS port Tailscale uses for remote access (the address is `https://<this Mac>.ts.net:<port>`). Tailscale only allows these three. 8443 leaves 443 to anything you already serve.

kiroCliChat.remote.port.markdownDescription: Local port for remote access (it only listens on 127.0.0.1). 0 reuses the port of last time when it is free, otherwise picks a free one.
